_comment: Reference example exercising every part of the pipeline: both version fields, a fixed-offset patch, and a pattern-located patch. Every replacement is byte-length-identical - mandatory, because these strings are referenced from literal pools and moving them would invalidate every pointer into the table.

patches._note: MONO-%03d.WAV -> TAKE-%03d.WAV (fixed offset; mono take template)
STE-%03d.WAV -> STE_%03d.WAV (located by pattern; stereo take template)
